content.title: Apply waitForResponse fix to sibling parent-selector test

content.reason: Blocker issue mqgzjnns95 transitioned to done

content.content:
Applied the waitForResponse attach-order fix to the "sets a parent via search and selection" test (phase3-validation.spec.ts:1235), mirroring the pattern already used in the "changes an existing parent" sibling.

Changes:
- Hoisted the searchResponsePromise (page.waitForResponse) ABOVE the searchInput.fill that triggers the request.
- Scoped the matcher precisely: GET method + URL contains /api/issues + new URL(...).searchParams.get('search') === 'Set Parent Target', so it can't latch onto an unrelated GET /api/issues?search= call.
- await searchResponsePromise after the fill.

Validation:
- Targeted test passes (Parent Selector block: 5/5 passed across 3 consecutive runs).
- Full e2e suite: one clean run of 170 passed / 0 failed. An earlier run showed 4 intermittent failures in unrelated tests (new-issue dialog, relation-collapsed, URL assignee filter) — these are pre-existing flakiness, not related to this change.
- No other instances of this search-response anti-pattern remain in the file (per the mqgzjnns95 audit), so this is the last one.

No typecheck/lint script is configured for the webapp package (bun + Playwright only); relied on Playwright as the validation gate.
